items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT

items.actClause:
AN ACT in relation to authorizing the town of Brookhaven in Suffolk county to
alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purposes of installing a
cellular tower
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S9079

SPONSOR: PALUMBO
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the town of Brookhaven in Suffolk
county to alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purposes of
installing a cellular tower

 
PURPOSE:

To allow the town of Brookhaven to alienate a parcel of parkland in
Percy Raynor Park in Setauket for the installation of a cell tower.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to discontinue as parkland
and to lease such parkland to Tag Towers LLC for installation of a
cellular tower

Section 2. The town of Brookhaven must dedicate a parcel of same size
toward the acquisition of new parklands and/or capital improvement to
existing park and recreational facilities.

Section 3. Describes the coordinates of the 2 parcels.

Section 4. States that if the lease terminates the lands revert to the
town of Brookhaven for public park and recreational purposes. Also, the
cellular tower shall be removed, and the property will return to its
previous state.

Section 5. lithe town of Brookhaven receives any funding from the feder-
al government for the purchase, maintenance or improvement of the park-
lands the alienation will not occur until certain requirements are
satisfied.

Section 6. Sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The town of Brookhaven has identified a need to enhance wireless commu-
nication infrastructure to improve service and connectivity. Thw town
will dedicate funds towards the acquisition of new parkland and/or
towards capital improvement to existing parkland and recreational facil-
ities. .

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately

A.actClause:
AN ACT in relation to authorizing the town of Brookhaven in Suffolk county to
alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purposes of installing a
cellular tower
A.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S9079A

SPONSOR: PALUMBO
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the town of Brookhaven in Suffolk
county to alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purposes of
installing a cellular tower

 
PURPOSE:

To authorize the Town of Brookhaven to lease certain parklands in Percy
Raynor Park in Setauket, for the purposes of installing a cellular tower
and to provide an easement for the installation of an associated subsur-
face electric cable.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1.

Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to discontinue as parkland and to
lease such parkland for 30 years to Tag Towers LLC for installation of a
cellular tower provided that the. Town dedicate all proceed from the
lease towards the acquisition of new parklands and/or capital improve-
ment to existing park and recreational facilities; and Authorizes the
Town to provide an easement for the installation of associated subsur-
face electrical cables, provided that, upon the completion of the
installation, Tag Towers LLC restores the surface, and land continues to
be used for park purposes.

Section 2.

Provides the metes and bounds for the lease area

Section 3.

Provides the metes and bounds for the easement area.

Section 4.

States that if the lease terminates the lands revert to the town of
Brookhaven for public park and recreational purposes. Also, the cellular
tower shall be removed, and the property will return to its previous
state.

Section 5.

If the town of Brookhaven receives any funding from the federal govern-
ment for the purchase, maintenance or improvement of the parklands the
alienation will not occur until certain requirements are satisfied.

Section 6.

Sets forth the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Town of Brookhaven has formally requested state support to enhance
its wireless communication infrastructure to improve service reliability
and public connectivity. The town has also identified the acquisition of
new parkland and capital improvements to existing park and recreational
facilities as priority projects and has committed to dedicating local
funds toward these efforts.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately

summary: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to lease such lands for a cell tower installation.
